frameConditions: Same machine, two existing isolated clients; rendered 800x600 windows for HUD audit; target 120 FPS, vSync off; wall-clock frame samples; no unmodded baseline. Lowest 1% means reciprocal of the slowest 1% mean time. Loading windows are separate.

knownIssues.observation: Second host-first Vengefly entry had matching active camera locks and visible boss/peer, but camera mode FROZEN.
knownIssues.cameraGateConfirmedScope: Both peers reject actual non-hazard FreezeInPlace immediately and a real spike-triggered freeze with explicitly blocked native recovery after 15 real-time seconds. Normal actual spike recovery completes without forcing camera changes. These differential controls verify the acceptance gate, not the old host sample's unique cause. Final twelve-case production-hash suite passes independently; this historical finding remains unresolved.
knownIssues.confirmedScope: Real native Cloud Hazard collisions invoke FreezeInPlace through PlayerDeadFromHazard and recover camera/input on both clients. The exact old guest coordinate can trigger this path. The shared room gate now permits only a known hazard animation with recovery within 15 seconds; it never forces camera mode. The unique old host freeze source was not recorded and remains unconfirmed.
knownIssues.releaseRequirement: Identify the freeze source, distinguish a native transition from a persistent failure, and verify the resulting correction. Successful retries alone do not resolve this finding.

knownIssues.observation: Authority transfer after disconnect left Hornet waiting in Thrown with an inactive needle; natural recovery timed out in two stress runs.
knownIssues.releaseRequirement: The latest targeted runs passed, but do not uniquely explain or resolve the earlier failures. Capture reliable updates and activation across takeover before classifying the finding as resolved.
knownIssues.latestScopedValidation: Story-placement pressure run story-rescue-full-20261021-final-lifecycle-host-013 timed out in Thrown; same-hash retry passed. Latest settlement pre-bump room matrix passed both authority orders. These do not resolve the historical intermittent root cause.

arenaFixValidation20261103.observation: First needle-phase transfer left Hornet in Thrown with inactive Needle and no active native needle Control state; Throw Recover timed out after 20 seconds. Host-first stress passed eight transfers on the same frozen build.
arenaFixValidation20261103.classification: Matching unresolved historical symptom; cause and current change impact on trigger frequency remain unconfirmed. Failure retained without unchanged retries.

knownIssues.observation: After late entry and authority transfer, False Knight did not expose its head after the next armour break within the original 20-second assertion.
knownIssues.releaseRequirement: Retain the original failure; successful later runs do not establish its cause. Capture damage and native phase transitions if it recurs.

knownIssues.observation: Both players bought the Crossroads map with shared permanent progress enabled; peer avatars became persistently invisible, peer map/name positions continued updating, crossing rooms did not restore visibility, reopening the multiplayer room temporarily restored it.
knownIssues.diagnostic: One private client log lacks committed room snapshots at visits 9 through 11. Localhost native purchase probes did not reproduce the issue. Room entry and stale-scope logging was added; no visibility repair is claimed.
knownIssues.releaseRequirement: Capture both client and server logs at reproduction and identify the failed entry/snapshot/avatar lifecycle before marking resolved.

knownIssues.observation: User 0.1.15 logs contain four UpdateHostFsmData String snapshot index errors in Mines_11. The later null-string omission fix does not establish the cause or resolve the layout error.
knownIssues.releaseRequirement: Reproduce with both peers entity and FSM variable layouts, then validate the cause-specific correction. Do not resize arrays or skip values to hide the error.
knownIssues.latestUpdate: 0.1.20 retains common bounds protection and deduplicates repeated state-index diagnostics. Actual Mines_11 layout-change source remains unconfirmed; not closed.

knownIssues.releaseRequirement: Retain the failed run and distinguish local input eligibility, server rejection, delivery and response eligibility on recurrence. A later successful run does not resolve this observation.

knownIssues.resolution: Retain as a timing observation, not an additional confirmed gameplay bug.

knownIssues.observation: User reports three players unable to act in the ordinary Grimm tent; only a screenshot is available, without reporter version, native FSM states or network history. Four selected current-build dual-client native intro/refight/angry-roar cases passed; the screenshot cause remains undetermined.
Repeated victory notifications can create a second ticket and approximately 15 seconds of additional settlement wait. Permanent softlock not established.
The entity completion sender construction has no reachable production call site; controlled fallback checks do not demonstrate a live end-to-end insurance path.
User 0.1.38 screenshot reports all three players trapped. Four three-player normal-flow old/current shared ON/OFF comparisons passed the left exit; original incident not reproduced.
Death/save accounting when disconnecting while downed still needs dedicated end-to-end validation; actual save corruption is not established.
Godseeker new-game PlayerData replacement and statistics isolation still need runtime validation.
Delayed room entry after connecting does not cover the first network connection during active combat.
Arrival/retry waiting recovery lacks a bounded timeout path; player consequences require scenario validation.
Reporter described a high probability of one-client process exit with a custom StagTunnelRun.webm. No process crash reproduced locally, including old-build baseline video playback.
knownIssues.confirmedScope: A distinct managed animation frame-index exception was reproduced and fixed. A duplicate native/Custom Knight video Prepare sequence was confirmed and guarded in this mod. Five corrected two-client cases passed, including 48 video plays; these results do not establish the reported native crash cause.
